name: Winter Carnival
description: Join us for ice skating, hot chocolate, and live music. Activities for all ages including a kids' zone with face painting and crafts.
imageUrl: Bring your own skates or rent on-site for $5. Hot chocolate provided by local café.

name: Toddler Story Time
description: Interactive story time for children ages 0-5 with songs, movement, and crafts. Caregivers must attend with children.
imageUrl: Repeats every Wednesday until March 31st. Registration required online.

name: Accessible Art Workshop
description: Hands-on art workshop designed for participants with diverse abilities. All materials provided, no experience necessary.
notes: Wheelchair accessible studio with adjustable tables. ASL interpreter available upon request (email 48hrs in advance).

name: Farmers Market
description: Weekly outdoor farmers market featuring local produce, baked goods, crafts, and live music. Pet-friendly event.
imageUrl: Runs every Saturday May-October. Some vendors accept cash only. Accessible porta-potties on site.
